recalculate.name: Recalculate route
recalculate.description: Re-evaluate the route immediately, bypassing the dwell timer.

set_route_override.name: Set route override
set_route_override.description: Force routing to the radiator or the AC.

clear_conflicts.name: Clear conflicts
clear_conflicts.description: Acknowledge and clear the current conflict state.

force_handover.name: Force handover
force_handover.description: Complete a pending handover immediately, without waiting for the old target to become idle.

set_manual_override.name: Set manual override
set_manual_override.description: Apply a temperature or preset for a bounded time, then restore the latest schedule command.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: How long the override lasts. Defaults to the configured override duration.

preset_mode.name: Preset
preset_mode.description: Preset to apply for the override.

hvac_mode.name: HVAC mode
hvac_mode.description: Optional mode override. Use off to cancel the override and turn the proxy off.

cancel_manual_override.name: Cancel manual override
cancel_manual_override.description: Cancel the active override and restore the latest schedule command.

set_boost.name: Set boost
set_boost.description: Activate both targets for a bounded time. Requires boost to be enabled and the proxy to be heating.

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: Which targets to activate. Only both is supported in this release.

cancel_boost.name: Cancel boost
cancel_boost.description: End boost immediately and return to normal routing.

lock.name: Lock
lock.description: Lock the router so user and automation commands are rejected.

unlock.name: Unlock
unlock.description: Unlock the router. A code is required when one is configured.

code.name: Code
code.description: The configured lock code, if any.
